about_the_game:
Dive into the darkness and madness with this VR action that blends shooter and horror elements. Expect intense combat, terrifying enemies, and mysterious missions in a world where every step could be your last. Fight monstrous creatures, level up your skills, and uncover the secrets of a corporation conducting deadly experiments.

Intense Combat System

Use a wide array of weapons—from pistols and assault rifles to flamethrowers and turrets. Every battle demands precision and quick reflexes.

Hero Progression

Upgrade your skills: increase your fire rate, boost damage, activate sniper mode, and customize weapons to suit your playstyle. Progression gives you a real advantage in battle.

Surprises in Every Mission

Each location is unique. The process of their generation ensures that each playthrough is truly different. Crack codes, rescue survivors, and wipe out hostile forces.

Horror Atmosphere

Dark, claustrophobic spaces, grotesque creatures, and sudden attacks. Constant fear and tension in every minute of gameplay.

Enemies You Can’t Ignore

Aliens, mutants, dinosaurs, and other horrific creations. Every enemy requires its own tactics and preparation.

Boss Fights

After completing missions, you’ll face epic battles with giant bosses that will test your skills and endurance.
